Since \(d_n\mid 401\) and \(401\) is prime, the only possible values are \(1\) and \(401\).

For \(n=200\),
\[
a_{200}=100+200^2=40100=401\cdot 100,
\]
and
\[
2n+1=401.
\]
Thus \(401\mid a_{200}\) and \(401\mid a_{201}\), so \(d_{200}=401\).

Therefore, the maximum value is
\[
\boxed{401}.
\]
